values.note: BLM's page states '$20.00 Per Night' (page descriptions dated May 2025); fee box on site.

fees.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/coal-banks-landing ('Fees: $20.00 Per Night'; 'a fee payment box'; 'Descriptions and photos uploaded May 2025'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Only five of the 20 sites take trailers or RVs (up to 40 ft); each site has a fire ring and picnic table.

sites.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/coal-banks-landing ('There are 20 sites, five (5) of which can accommodate trailers or recreational vehicles (RVs) up to 40 feet in length.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Potable water runs after the last spring freeze, typically by May 15. Trash dumpsters; BLM contact station.

facilities.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/coal-banks-landing ('The potable water system at the campground becomes operational after the last freeze in the spring, typically by May 15th', 'equipped with vault toilets and trash dumpsters'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/coal-banks-landing ('Coal Banks Landing Campground ... is open from April 1 to December 1, annually.'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/coal-banks-landing ('Campsites are on a first-come, first-serve basis — NO RESERVATIONS.', 'Stay Limit: 14 Days'), read 2026-10-22

note: BLM Coal Banks Landing recreation site on the Upper Missouri River (Upper Missouri River Breaks National Monument, Lewistown Field Office), 6-8 mi of improved gravel off US-87 via Virgelle Ferry Road. Contact station and concrete boat ramp (motorized launching needs roughly 5,000-7,000 cfs); a popular Missouri River float launch. --Claude
summary: BLM-run (Lewistown Field Office), FCFS, no reservations. Confirmed 20 sites (5 RV-capable to 40 ft), no hookups, vault toilets, seasonal potable water, FCFS; added $20/night, season Apr 1 - Dec 1, 14-day limit. Note trimmed of restated values.
flags: Missing phone: BLM Lewistown Field Office 406-538-1900 (https://www.blm.gov/office/lewistown-field-office), which BLM's page names as the managing office.
Waterfront re-audit lead (weak): BLM says the campground is 'situated along the Upper Missouri River' at a boat launch; the entry is riverview.
The rec.gov link in `website` is a POI page (recreation.gov/camping/poi/262732), not a bookable campground; the BLM page is the operator's own.
